notes.title: Punchimals Demo - Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]It's Finally Here![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/4152b28310a14d7f0d969596e21cd71788256b2c.png[/img]

Get ready to beat up your friends (in a good way) because the Punchimals demo is now available on Steam!

I've spent close to a year working on Punchimals and this demo represents the culmination of all that work (for now) as development switches gear. The next phase of development will be working on things like Network Multiplayer and Survival Coop mode. For now please enjoy local versus mode against your friends or the CPU

[h1]Demo Features[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/f4bb1eabe16e3cf8e33e8403b4f852684fe6f386.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/9085b4eccc165288478c5d9b5ca884ec17a44774.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/83fc8944884337693fbbe2d86a5b76af451f4a2d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/62c48687e643ce809e440b40fc819108de5bc432.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/87c5ce0eff9dc7a83e0e65767e752dc5e5d71acf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300852/421e639946802d6e0071e3d7386a8abc8e30bd03.png[/img][/url]
